name: Swiss German
bridgesBlurb: One rule, many words. Read the trick, then build each word yourself before you reveal it.
phoneticsSubtitle: An English-style respelling under the Swiss sentence — CAPS is the stressed syllable.

reminders.title: 🇨🇭 Grüezi! Ziit für Züritüütsch
reminders.body: Your daily sentences are waiting. Chumm, los gaht's! 🚀

reminders.title: 🧀 Your Swiss German is hungry
reminders.body: Ich han Hunger! Feed it a few Sätzli — two minutes, that's all.

reminders.title: 🔥 Nöd vergässe!
reminders.body: Your streak is still alive… but only just. Es paar Sätzli hüt? 💪

reminders.title: 🚂 Punctual like a Swiss train ⏰
reminders.body: Right on time for today's Züritüütsch. Bisch parat?

reminders.title: ☕ Kafi und Züritüütsch
reminders.body: Best combo in Zürich. Five sentences, denn hesch es gschafft! 😎

reminders.title: 🐄 Muuuh!
reminders.body: Even the Chue thinks you should practise. Chumm scho! 🇨🇭

reminders.title: 🍫 Schoggi first? Nei nei.
reminders.body: Earn it — es paar Sätzli warted uf dich. Denn chasch schlemme. 😋

reminders.title: ⛰️ Chli üebe hüt?
reminders.body: Small steps up the Üetliberg. Five sentences and you're at the top! 🥾

reminders.title: 🎿 All downhill from here
reminders.body: You've done the hard bit before. Hüt au? Los gaht's! ⛷️

reminders.title: 🧗 Mach witer!
reminders.body: Keep going — dini Serie isch no am Läbe. Just a few sentences. 🔥

reminders.title: 🔔 Bimmel-bimmel!
reminders.body: That's your Züritüütsch bell. Chumm, mir mached das zäme! 🐐

reminders.title: 🥨 Znüni-Ziit für dis Hirni
reminders.body: A little snack for your brain. Es paar Sätz und fertig! 🧠
